slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: elegant, calm wedding paperwork moment that signals 'this is simple and handled' for a luxury reader.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2, room for a title on one side. Overhead or 45 degree still life on cream linen or a marble desk: a pair of wedding rings, a fine fountain pen, a blank or softly blurred sheet of ivory paper, a few loose white florals or an olive sprig, soft natural window light, warm neutral palette, no people, no hands. No real, readable government form (no legible NOIM text, fields or crest) and no real personal documents: any paperwork must be blank, out of focus or turned so nothing is legible, with no names, numbers, signatures or photos. Source order: Canva brand asset, or licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to library-index.csv. Never a competitor, directory, celebrant-blog or search-result image. An AI still life is allowed only if the user approves, and must be labelled 'Illustrative image' in the caption.
